entries.name: Scavenge
entries.rationale: A named important interrupt from Keen-Eyed Strikers before the first boss.

entries.name: Healing Breeze
entries.rationale: Interrupt the Earthwhisper Tender's heal; purge its Magic effect only as recovery after a missed stop.

entries.name: Frigid Roar
entries.rationale: Stop the Frigid Mauler's named priority cast.

entries.name: Winter's Shroud
entries.rationale: Interrupt the Fractured Shivercore cast during Sentinel of Winter.

entries.name: Arc Lightning
entries.rationale: A named important interrupt from Stormbound Mystics in the final section.

entries.name: Insatiable Hunger
entries.rationale: Remove the Curse associated with the Spirit of Hunger encounter object.

entries.name: Toxic Spores
entries.rationale: Cleanse the Poison applied during The Hoardmonger.

entries.name: Cryo Surge
entries.rationale: Remove the Glacial Revenant's Magic debuff in the winter section.

entries.name: Glacial Torment
entries.rationale: Plan Magic dispels for Sentinel of Winter's named priority debuff.

entries.name: Mother's Wrath
entries.rationale: Remove the Territorial Matriarch's Enrage to reduce tank pressure.

entries.name: Bestial Wrath
entries.rationale: Remove the Bonded Beasttamer's Enrage rather than treating it as a friendly dispel.

provenance.description: Interrupt, dispel, purge, and Enrage-removal priorities were independently summarized from Wowhead's Patch 12.1 dungeon overview.
Spell IDs, NPC contexts, and low-level response flags are linked to the generated Midnight Season 2 ability index.
